title: Alchymy's Compendium
description: A modpack focused on enchancing the vanilla gameplay, without adding anything to the game that changes how you play drastically.
body:
Alchymy’s Compendium is a carefully curated vanilla-enhancing modpack designed to refine and expand the core Minecraft experience without losing the soul of the game. Every mod included respects the original design philosophy of Minecraft, focusing on client-side improvements that feel natural, immersive, and balanced.

Rather than transforming the game into something completely different, this pack acts like a collection of carefully selected improvements; a compendium of tweaks that make Minecraft smoother, deeper, and more enjoyable while still unmistakably vanilla.

**Inside you’ll find:**

**Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay**

**Quality-of-life improvements that streamline common tasks**

**Vanilla-friendly visuals that stay true to Minecraft’s aesthetic**

**Subtle gameplay enhancements that feel like they could have always existed**

**No overpowered tech trees.**
**No progression overhauls.**
**No mechanics that overshadow survival.**

**Just Minecraft—refined, polished, and thoughtfully expanded.**

Alchymy’s Compendium is perfect for players who want a clean, authentic survival experience with modern improvements that make the world feel more alive and enjoyable to play in for the long term.
